messages:
Maya: Heads-up — partner-ACME's marketplace image is failing our smoke on driver 530.12. Failing in perf CI (OOM on 16GB A100). Log snippet:
```
E tensorflow: out of memory at kv_cache_alloc 0x7f...
```
Sam: saw a similar regression in internal nightly with 530 -> 531 patch. suspect driver+CUDA runtime interaction.
Ranjit: Partner says they updated CUDA to 12.2 and pinned driver to 530.12 yesterday. Need to triage: kernel ABI vs quant-kernel change.
Kevin: repro command: `./run_inference --model giraffe --batch 8 --seq 4096`. Reproduced on 16GB A100 with driver 530.12. Stack trace: ```kernel_launch failed: invalid configuration```
Maya: Can we try rolling back to driver 525.85 on a canary image to confirm? If that fixes, propose pin in marketplace listing.
Sam: I'll spin a canary in us-west2 on a dedicated nodepool, will test 525.85 vs 530.12. ETA ~30m.
deploy-bot: canary-started us-west2-pool-3 (canary id c-2076543210)
Ranjit: Also check ROCm side — partner runs some CI on AMD instances. I'll run ROCm smoke in parallel.
Olivia: I'll ping partner PM and ask for their kernel configs and the exact binary they pushed. Also putting a hold on the joint announcement until cleared.
Kevin: If rollback works, prep a hotfix that pins 525.* with a compatibility note in marketplace + rollback playbook.
Maya: Action items: Sam validate canary, Kevin draft pin PR + playbook, Olivia coordinate partner comms & announcement hold, Ranjit run ROCm smoke.
Sam: update: 20m in — initial tests show 525.85 passes the repro. Saving logs -> https://logs.redwood/integration/c-2076543210
Maya: Great. Kevin can you draft the PR and tag eng-runtime & eng-platform?
Kevin: Drafting PR now: `repo infra/marketplace-pin-driver` branch `pin-driver-525-hotfix`.
deploy-bot: PR created #1456 by Kevin.
Olivia: Partner PM ✅ — asked them to hold marketplace promotion. They uploaded one binary for us to test.
Ranjit: ROCm smoke shows no regression on MI100 with ROCm 5.5.0. Seems NVIDIA-only.
Maya: Holding for 2hr observation window. If canary stays green, we'll merge a canary pin and coordinate a controlled rollout. If not, escalate to vendor support.
Sam: canary steady for 45m, no failures. moving to green.
Maya: Update: merging PR after remaining 1hr observation. Notifying compliance & release channels. :thumbsup:
